newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Oct oil output falls 0.28 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Oct oil output falls 0.28 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Ecuador produced an average of 387,374 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil in October, down 0.28 percent from the same month last year, an official said Monday.
An official from Petroleum National Direction, who asked not to be named, said that in October 1995 the country produced an average of 388,469 bpd.
Ecuador's average production in the first ten months was 384,496 bpd, he added, without giving a comparative figure for 1995.
Oil production in Ecuador reached last year to an average of 386,706 bpd.
In September 1996, oil production was 384,526 bpd.
